scope: Frozen readonly real owner/clock/publisher/hub plus formal Focus/KTV; same original audio, 1x, 65–115.5s, three paired A/B runs per source, cold/warm separate. Trace OFF, identical geometry/fine probes ON; not physical-display/OBS acceptance.

completion.quantile: Sorted floor(n*p) zero-based (upper middle at p=.5); not arithmetic median
completion.cueScope: Unique-text post-onset visibility only; early timing unknown, KTV phrase/page cue identities not scored

traceDiagnostic.scope: Trace-on targeted 65–72s; first second of cold and warm plus 30ms pre-anchor allowance; separate from trace-disabled complete A/B. Maxima of distinct subphases are not additive.
